courseTitle: NativeScript + Angular: Build Native iOS, Android & Web Apps

cues.en: So you built your app just as we did in this course, and of course, you don't just want to play around
with it on your local phone, you want to publish it.
You probably want to publish it in the Apple App Store or Google Play store in this module.
I'll walk you through the steps you need to go through to achieve that.
And by the end of this module, you'll be ready to ship your app, be that the one you built in this
course or any other app to the app stores and hopefully get many users.
